surface_strategy.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-gray-200), no drop shadows, hard square edges or very minimal rounding (rounded-sm).
surface_strategy.headers: Crystal Glass - bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-200.
surface_strategy.grid_borders: Use border-collapse techniques to expose the grid skeleton in dense data views.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm edges. High contrast. Primary buttons must be brand.primary with white text. Hover states must be explicitly defined and high contrast.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: 1px solid border, completely flat, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7]. No shadows.
components.cards: Cardless or completely flat rectangular containers. Avoid standard Shadcn card shadow.
components.animations: Minimal and snappy. Use framer-motion for micro-interactions only, not distracting.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORT FONTS: Include the Fontshare @import in your global CSS to load Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi.

LANDING PAGE: Build using pure HTML/Tailwind. Use 'hero_background' with an appropriate overlay (bg-white/40 for light theme or bg-black/50 if you invert it). Implement a high-impact 'Bento Grid' layout for features.
ROUTING & ONBOARDING: Implement the exact flow: Landing -> Register -> Login -> Role Selection (Individual, Sole Prop, OPC, Pvt Ltd) -> Dynamic Onboarding wizard.
WIZARD UI: Design the multi-step onboarding wizard using progressive disclosure. The form should feel like a secure 'Swiss-designed' application—flat, clear, high contrast.
32-BIT BITMASK SYSTEM: Implement the status bitmask logic exactly as requested (PAN=1, GST=2, CIN=4, Consent=8, AIS=16, ITR=32, Account=64).

DASHBOARD UI: Build a 'Control Room' dense dashboard layout. Visually represent the 32-bit status using a technical UI element (e.g., a series of 7 binary toggle lights, mono-spaced binary output, or a step-progress bar).
COMPONENT OVERRIDES: Use Shadcn UI for forms, tabs, and tables, but strip away any soft shadows or rounded-xl corners to fit the Archetype 4 Swiss Brutalist vibe.
ACCESSIBILITY: EVERY interactive element (buttons, forms, links, progress indicators) MUST have a descriptive 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case format.
